selected_evidence.requirement: Containerized web app running as appsvc, serving on port 8080, no active login session
selected_evidence.summary: Installed podman, pulled nginx:alpine as appsvc, created and enabled webapp.service (rootless podman container on port 8080), verified port listening and HTTP 200, and confirmed zero login sessions (loginctl list-sessions: 'No sessions') while service ran

selected_evidence.requirement: Starts at boot (survives restart) while account has no active session
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id (901ef286...) and active service/HTTP 200; issued systemctl reboot which returned before disconnect; polled node1 and observed new boot_id (18574b17...) confirming genuine restart; verified webapp.service came back active/enabled, port 8080 serving HTTP 200, fresh podman/nginx process tree under appsvc, and no login sessions post-reboot
